text: Sibling evidence from b7z9.50.1 (landed): (1) build+run commands verified locally on heft: cmake lichen/tests/fuzz -B <dir> -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang && cmake --build <dir>, then ./fuzz_frame 50000 42 / ./fuzz_schnorr48 50000 42 / ./fuzz_schc 50000 42 — all exit 0 under ASan/UBSan; use the SAME commands in the job, with a FIXED seed argument (the standalone driver defaults to time(NULL), so fixed seed = reproducible CI) and a timeout. (2) clang 20.1.8 on the runner image must exist (ubuntu-latest has it). (3) Twister -T lichen/tests/fuzz discovers nothing because the dir is a standalone host CMake project (no find_package(Zephyr), no testcase.yaml) — the job should invoke cmake directly, not west twister.
